statement.name: GetAllItems
statement.sql:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @ConfigurationKeyValues TABLE (LookupCode varchar(50) NOT NULL, [Key] varchar(36) NOT NULL, Value varchar(max) NULL);
--*** Solution Configured Values ***-- --Environment Specific for Current External System INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_SolutionWebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue= AND c.UserTypeCode = AND c.ExternalSystemsCode = INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode AND n.OverrideFlag=1
--All Environments for Current External System INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_SolutionWebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue='All' AND c.UserTypeCode = AND c.ExternalSystemsCode = INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode AND n.OverrideFlag=1 WHERE n.LookupCode NOT IN(select LookupCode from @ConfigurationKeyValues)
-- EIS Config for current environment (where we don't have any user and external system code) INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_SolutionWebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue= AND c.ExternalSystemsCode = AND c.ExternalSystemDimensionCode= INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode AND n.OverrideFlag=1 WHERE n.LookupCode NOT IN(select LookupCode from @ConfigurationKeyValues)
-- EIS Config for all environments (where we don't have any user and external system code) INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_SolutionWebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue='All' AND c.ExternalSystemsCode = AND c.ExternalSystemDimensionCode= INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode AND n.OverrideFlag=1 WHERE n.LookupCode NOT IN(select LookupCode from @ConfigurationKeyValues)
--*** Platform Configured Values ***-- -- Current Environment INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_WebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue = AND c.UserTypeCode = AND (c.ExternalSystemsCode = OR c.ExternalSystemsCode IS NULL) INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode WHERE c.WebConfigNodeCode NOT IN(select LookupCode from @ConfigurationKeyValues) ORDER BY c.ExternalSystemsCode DESC
--All Environments INSERT INTO @ConfigurationKeyValues(LookupCode, [Key], Value) SELECT n.LookupCode as LookupCode, n.DisplayValue as [Key], c.WebConfigValue as Value FROM LU_PFM_Environment e INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_WebConfig_P c ON e.LookupCode=c.EnvironmentCode AND e.DisplayValue = 'All' AND c.UserTypeCode = AND (c.ExternalSystemsCode = OR c.ExternalSystemsCode IS NULL) INNER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n on n.LookupCode=c.WebConfigNodeCode WHERE c.WebConfigNodeCode NOT IN(select LookupCode from @ConfigurationKeyValues) ORDER BY c.ExternalSystemsCode DESC
SELECT [Key], Value FROM @ConfigurationKeyValues

statement.name: GetUrls
statement.sql:
SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ConfigUrls') IS NOT NULL BEGIN DROP TABLE #ConfigUrls END
-- Urls Select ( CAST(ExternalSystemCode as Varchar(MAX))+'_'+CAST(ExternalSystemDimensionCode as VARchar(MAX)) ) as [Key], DimensionValue as Value into #ConfigUrls from ExternalSystemDimensionValue
--*********************************************************************************************** -- Handling the EHB2010 Scenarious (Exception) This needs to be removed once EHB fixes their code --***********************************************************************************************
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM LU_PFM_WebConfigNode n INNER JOIN PFM_WebConfig_P p ON n.LookupCode=p.WebConfigNodeCode AND p.ExternalSystemsCode IS NULL WHERE n.DisplayValue='HandleEHB2010LookupException' and p.WebConfigValue='1') BEGIN DECLARE @CurrenExternalUrl VARCHAR(MAX) SELECT @CurrenExternalUrl= ISNULL(DimensionValue,'') FROM ExternalSystemDimensionValue WHERE ExternalSystemCode=42 and ExternalSystemDimensionCode=28
IF @CurrenExternalUrl != '' BEGIN UPDATE #ConfigUrls SET Value=@CurrenExternalUrl WHERE [Key]='42_27' END END
SELECT * FROM #ConfigUrls DROP TABLE #ConfigUrls
